templates.familia_base: Família C — duas camadas + handle (extraído do moodboard original)
templates.quando_usar: capa de caso único com objeto/cena documental em close-up (arquivos, caixas, documentos, ambiente do caso)

scene.description: A moody archival-style photograph or period-accurate scene illustrating [CASO/TEMA HISTÓRICO], dark graphite tones with rust-orange accent lighting, subtle film grain. Dominant palette: graphite #1B1D1E background, rust #C13B00 accents, solid black bottom bar with white text. Handle '@historia_proibida' centered between two thin horizontal white rules, flanked by diamond dividers, below a two-tier white headline.
scene.subject: [FIGURA/CENA/OBJETO DO CASO HISTÓRICO]
scene.setting: period-accurate setting matching the case's era and location

style.primary: vintage archival photography, unsettling/investigative editorial tone
style.lighting: single directional key light with rust-orange accent, deep graphite shadow

technical.rendering: monochrome or desaturated grade, heavy grain, subtle vignette

materials.surfaces: period-accurate fabric, worn wood/stone, aged paper/document texture

environment.atmosphere: flat overcast light or dim interior haze

composition.perspective: documentary framing with natural leading lines
composition.framing: subject off-center per rule of thirds
composition.subject_placement: subject fills upper 2/3, headline block bottom third
composition.ui_elements: Handle text '@historia_proibida' centered directly between two thin horizontal white rules (no circular emblem, no initials), flanked by small white diamond bullet dividers on either side of the text. Below, solid graphite/black #1B1D1E bar, 2-line white Tusker Grotesk condensed all-caps headline: '[LINHA FINA DE CONTEXTO]' (thinner) / '[LINHA BOLD DO CASO]' (bold, larger, optionally in rust #C13B00).

templates.familia_base: Família B — colagem tríptica (extraído do moodboard original)
templates.quando_usar: capa de caso com múltiplos locais/momentos (ex: linha do tempo de um desaparecimento, mapa de eventos, antes/depois de um lugar)

scene.description: A vertical collage split into 2-3 bands showing different locations/moments tied to [CASO], each in a dessaturated dossier tone. Dominant palette: graphite #1B1D1E, slate #5E6D70 map/timeline overlays, rust #C13B00 accent marks. Thin white divider line with no emblem, followed by the handle '@historia_proibida' centered below it, then a bold headline in white on the solid graphite/black bottom bar.
scene.subject: 2-3 related locations/timeline moments of the historical case
scene.setting: varies per band — real locations tied to the case, map overlays

style.lighting: flat diffused documentary lighting per band

technical.rendering: seamless band transitions, dessaturated grade with rust/slate overlay graphics

materials.surfaces: period-accurate location textures, paper/map overlay texture

environment.atmosphere: dossier paper-grain overlay, faint scan-line texture

composition.perspective: split-band collage with timeline/map graphic elements
composition.subject_placement: scenes fill top 2/3, headline bar bottom 1/3
composition.ui_elements: Plain thin white horizontal rule with no emblem or logo. Directly below it, the handle '@historia_proibida' centered in small white text. Below that, solid graphite/black #1B1D1E bar with bold white Tusker Grotesk all-caps headline, 2 lines, with one key word in rust #C13B00: '[HOOK LINE 1]' / '[HOOK LINE 2]'.

include: high contrast white on black bar
quality.reference_standard: True-crime documentary dossier collage editorial style
